description: This file defines the CurrencyField class, which manages currency formatting, conversion, and display for a CRM system, including handling user-specific currency settings and formatting patterns.

classes.name: CurrencyField
classes.description: A class for handling currency formatting, conversion, and display, including user-specific settings and formatting patterns.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the currency value.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes user's currency settings such as pattern, separator, symbol, and rate.

methods.name: setNumberofDecimals
methods.description: Sets the number of decimal places.

methods.name: convertToUserFormat
methods.description: Converts a value to the user's formatted currency string.

methods.name: getDisplayValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted currency value for display, optionally skipping conversion.

methods.name: getDisplayValueWithSymbol
methods.description: Returns the formatted currency value with the currency symbol.

methods.name: appendCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Appends the currency symbol to a value based on user preference.

methods.name: _formatCurrencyValue
methods.description: Formats the numeric value according to the configured pattern and separators.

methods.name: getDBInsertedValue
methods.description: Returns the numeric value suitable for database insertion, converting and stripping formatting.

methods.name: convertToDBFormat
methods.description: Static method to convert a value into database format.

methods.name: getDBCurrencyId
methods.description: Retrieves the default system currency ID from the database.
